description: Create Amazon product photos for a clean main image, detail views, and in-use shots from one upload. You pay in credits, and you see the cost before each file.
h1: Amazon Product Photos for the Main Image and the Gallery
lead: Build a plain main image, a detail, and an in-use photo from one product photo. Make one file, or many at once (a batch). Your own shop software can start the same job (the API). A credit is what your plan spends on each file. You see that cost first, and the download has no watermark.
card: Amazon listing photos from one product photo: main, detail and in-use.

faq.q: What does Amazon require for the main image?
faq.a: Use a pure white background, let the product fill most of the square, and leave off text, badges, and extra objects. Confirm the current rule in Seller Central (Amazon's seller site) before you publish.

faq.q: What happens if an image does not meet the rules?
faq.a: Amazon can hide that picture, and the product can leave search until you replace it. Keep the main image plain. Put text labels only on later pictures.

faq.q: Can I make a white main from a regular photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a clear product photo and choose the plain white main image. The item sits on an empty background. You do not book a studio for that picture. The steps are in [Amazon white background photo](/guides/white-background-amazon).

faq.q: Can I make photos for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. One batch uses the same background and the same size on many products. Each file spends credits. The cost shows first. If a job fails, those credits come back.

faq.q: Which images should follow the main image?
faq.a: A close-up, a photo that shows the size, and a photo of the item in use. Each one answers the shopper's next question.

faq.q: Can I add text on the pictures?
faq.a: Add the text yourself after you download, and only on pictures after the main image. The main image stays free of badges and slogans.

faq.q: Can I make a video for the listing?
faq.a: Yes. A video is a separate job at 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. A 6-second video is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. A photo is 24 credits. Check Amazon's current Sponsored Brands rules (paid brand ads) and product-video rules before you use it.

faq.q: Will you upload the photos to Amazon for me?
faq.a: No. Download the file and add it in Seller Central yourself. We do not connect to your seller account, and we do not upload the pictures for you.

faq.q: Can my own shop software make the Amazon images?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your own shop software remove the background and set the same size your listings use. You still place the files in Seller Central yourself.
